name: Barbarian
description: A fierce front-line warrior who survives through strength, fury, and unreasonable confidence.

class_features.name: Rage
class_features.description: Enter Rage as a Bonus Action twice per Long Rest at level 1; while raging, gain physical damage resistance, Strength advantage, and +2 Strength-based damage.

class_features.name: Unarmored Defense
class_features.description: While not wearing armor, AC can use 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier, and a shield can still apply.

class_features.name: Weapon Mastery
class_features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds and use their mastery properties.

name: Bard
description: A versatile performer, talker, spellcaster, and professional problem complicator.

class_features.name: Bardic Inspiration
class_features.description: Use a Bonus Action to inspire another creature within 60 feet; the d6 can turn a failed D20 Test into a success.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Prepare Bard spells and cast them with Charisma.

name: Cleric
description: A divine spellcaster who supports, protects, and occasionally makes undead regret attendance.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Prepare Cleric spells and cast them with Wisdom.

class_features.name: Divine Order
class_features.description: Choose Protector for heavier combat training or Thaumaturge for deeper divine magic.

options.name: Protector
options.description: Gain Heavy armor training and Martial weapon proficiency.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.description: Gain one additional Cleric cantrip and deeper religious learning.

name: Druid
description: A nature spellcaster tied to beasts, weather, growth, rot, and the forest having opinions.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Prepare Druid spells and cast them with Wisdom.

class_features.name: Druidic
class_features.description: Know the secret Druidic language.

class_features.name: Primal Order
class_features.description: Choose Magician for more magic or Warden for sturdier combat training.

options.name: Magician
options.description: Gain one additional Druid cantrip and a more magical focus.

options.name: Warden
options.description: Gain Medium armor training and Martial weapon proficiency.

name: Fighter
description: A master of weapons and armor who solves many problems by standing exactly where danger happens.

class_features.name: Fighting Style
class_features.description: Choose one Fighting Style feat at level 1.

class_features.name: Second Wind
class_features.description: Use a Bonus Action to regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP; level 1 has two uses.

class_features.name: Weapon Mastery
class_features.description: Choose three proficient weapon kinds and use their mastery properties.

options.name: Archery
options.description: Gain a bonus to attacks you make with Ranged weapons.

options.name: Defense
options.description: Gain a defensive benefit while wearing armor.

options.name: Dueling
options.description: Improve damage while wielding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: Improve damage with Heavy two-handed or versatile weapons.

options.name: Protection
options.description: Protect a nearby ally with your shield as a Reaction.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: Improve damage with the extra attack from Light weapons.

name: Monk
description: A disciplined martial artist using speed, focus, and suspiciously effective elbows.

class_features.name: Martial Arts
class_features.description: Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons can use Dexterity and a d6 Martial Arts die; you can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

class_features.name: Unarmored Defense
class_features.description: While not wearing armor or using a shield, AC can use 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

name: Paladin
description: A sworn champion with armor, conviction, and the subtlety of a bell tower.

class_features.name: Lay on Hands
class_features.description: Use a Bonus Action to heal from a pool of 5 HP at level 1.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Prepare Paladin spells and cast them with Charisma.

class_features.name: Weapon Mastery
class_features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds and use their mastery properties.

name: Ranger
description: A wilderness warrior who tracks, scouts, shoots, and generally knows which berries are rude.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Prepare Ranger spells and cast them with Wisdom.

class_features.name: Favored Enemy
class_features.description: Hunter's Mark is always prepared and can be cast twice per Long Rest without a spell slot.

class_features.name: Weapon Mastery
class_features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds and use their mastery properties.

name: Rogue
description: A precise expert in skills, ambushes, locks, lies, and plausible deniability.

class_features.name: Expertise
class_features.description: Choose two skill proficiencies and double your Proficiency Bonus for them.

class_features.name: Sneak Attack
class_features.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage with a Finesse or Ranged weapon when you have Advantage or an ally adjacent to the target.

class_features.name: Thieves' Cant
class_features.description: Know Thieves' Cant.

class_features.name: Weapon Mastery
class_features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds and use their mastery properties.

name: Sorcerer
description: A spellcaster powered by innate magic, bloodline weirdness, or cosmic paperwork.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Prepare Sorcerer spells and cast them with Charisma.

class_features.name: Innate Sorcery
class_features.description: Twice per Long Rest, use a Bonus Action for 1 minute of +1 Sorcerer spell save DC and Advantage on Sorcerer spell attacks.

name: Warlock
description: A pact-bound spellcaster with borrowed power and absolutely no suspicious fine print.

class_features.name: Pact Magic
class_features.description: Prepare Warlock spells and cast them with Charisma using Pact Magic slots.

class_features.name: Eldritch Invocations
class_features.description: Choose one invocation at level 1.

options.name: Armor of Shadows
options.description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

options.name: Eldritch Mind
options.description: Gain Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.

options.name: Fiendish Vigor
options.description: You can cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot.

options.name: Pact of the Blade
options.description: Conjure or bond with a pact weapon for Warlock combat.

options.name: Pact of the Chain
options.description: Learn Find Familiar and gain a more potent familiar option.

options.name: Pact of the Tome
options.description: Gain a Book of Shadows with additional cantrips and rituals.

name: Wizard
description: A studied spellcaster who turns preparation, ink, and nerve into reality edits.

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Record six level 1 Wizard spells in your spellbook and prepare four of them.

class_features.name: Ritual Adept
class_features.description: Cast Wizard rituals from your spellbook even if they are not prepared.

class_features.name: Arcane Recovery
class_features.description: After a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots with total level up to half your Wizard level rounded up.
